name: Google AI Mode
summary: Google Search mode that answers with a sourced AI overview.
description: Google Search's AI Mode answers complex questions with a Gemini-written response and links to sources, and lets you ask follow-ups. It can also search from images or voice.
features: AI for search and research at google.com.
